observation: The four-column snowfield uses textured ice, blue holes, a character token and a wrapped goal.
A small ship and enemy sprites sit on a black field with score, lives and weapon status in the top band.
Flat brown/cream squares carry black and white figurative pieces without an enclosing console.
The landlord table uses a pale blue field, a tightly overlapped hand along the bottom and opponent counts at its top corners.
Four separated red 3×3 trays make the rotation units visible around black and white counters.
A large slanted hex lattice has coloured goal edges and two smaller analysis lattices alongside it.
Dealer and player hands sit inside an oval marking on dark green felt with controls below.
The project illustration uses vivid rectangular seat hands around a square central play area.
Four hands frame the green table, with blue-backed side hands and the current trick in the centre.
The grid has grass squares, a continuous cliff edge and a character hazard separate from the agent.
The board occupies the left of a dark dashboard while a vertically stacked round/event feed fills the right.
A wood-coloured river board supports both blank discs and revealed marked pieces beside a desktop analysis panel.
The spare blue playfield puts score and lives in opposite corners above a four-row brick wall.
A close-up gold intersection board places large contrasting stones beneath the mobile toolbar.
The theme specimen pairs an ornate burgundy card back with green felt; the contemporary specimen uses a geometric blue back.
The charcoal-and-silver board uses strongly silhouetted pieces, small capture markers and a narrow move strip.
Three concentric square tracks sit between vertical reserves of white and black pieces.
A tan intersection board places move markers beside the stones and a vertical command strip along the right.
A dark inset table holds two prominent central cards above action controls and a horizontal numbered hand.
Four tile walls surround the central discard area on green felt, with the visible hand at the bottom and chat to the side.
Rows of numbered colour cards sit beside an action log; a concealed row uses uniform grey backs.
The card hand forms one continuous, overlapping strip above a narrow score edge.
An olive-and-ivory grid carries large chess glyphs on a compact desktop board.
An angled wooden table and triangular points occupy the centre, with controls kept outside the playfield.
The perspective goban has reflective stones, a visible tabletop edge and separate stone bowls.
A tall U-shaped peg track is paired with a narrow player/score legend on the left.
A portrait trick table keeps the viewer’s fanned hand at the lower edge and played cards inside the central trick.
Ring ropes and fighter targets occupy the playfield, with a separate camera inset and health bars.
Blue glyphs on a dark three-by-three grid leave the result above and restart control below.
